static_spherical_PaW.clock_subsystem: Asymptotic Schwarzschild ADM Killing-energy generator (ideal continuous clock).
static_spherical_PaW.system_subsystem: Dressed scalar one-body sector on static spherical background.
static_spherical_PaW.magnetic_clock_analog: Spin-J magnetic clock with H_C = B J_0/J gives conditioning error ~ Omega_Gamma^2/(4 J B^2).
static_spherical_PaW.comment: Our construction has an actual physical Hamiltonian from symmetry reduction, not an a priori non-interacting bipartite ansatz; PaW is the conditional-state reading of that Hamiltonian.

source_mapping.Coppo2024: arXiv:2310.13386 / PRA 109 052212 (magnetic clock + harmonic oscillator, non-interacting PaW, generalized coherent states, classical limit).
source_mapping.Coppo2026: arXiv:2601.07437 (black holes as clocks with Hawking modes; uses same PaW conditions).
source_mapping.this_work: Symmetry-reduced physical ADM Hamiltonian on dressed self-gravitating spherical fields, with photon-echo readout and aspherical quadrupole robustness.
